description: Orchestrates evidence-led, adversarial audits and end-to-end improvement of AI skills and plugins, including controlled GitHub changes and verification.

defaultPrompt: Audit secara menyeluruh skill atau plugin ini, rumuskan perbaikannya, lalu implementasikan perubahan yang telah diotorisasi dan verifikasi hasilnya.
Bedah arsitektur prompt dan skill ini dengan SKILL ANALYZER serta Octa-Prompt, lakukan red-team, lalu buat patch dan regression test.
Periksa repository GitHub ini, identifikasi kelemahan utama, dan siapkan pembaruan melalui branch dan pull request yang dapat ditinjau.
interface.longDescription: A full-cycle engineering orchestrator for AI skills and plugins. It coordinates SKILL ANALYZER and Octa-Prompt methods, performs evidence-based root-cause analysis and red-team risk discovery, converts findings into prioritized improvements, then applies authorized changes to plugin assets and GitHub through verified capabilities. It uses branch-and-pull-request workflows, regression gates, traceable evidence, and fail-closed release decisions. It never claims tests, tool calls, permissions, or deployments that were not actually observed.

name: skill-developer-orchestrator
